about: Every screen name scripts/store-screenshots.sh photos captures for Tenshu Photos (`captured`, from the UI test in `uiTests`), on iPhone 6.9" and iPad 13", light. The library is the landing set's stock photos re-dated six to a day (store/fixtures/photos/), uploaded through Drive's own seed launch on the same realm; the albums and the favourite are made in Photos by taps (docs/how-to/store-screenshots.md §3d). Adding a capture means adding it here. `landing` is the landing page's own set (§9). Docs: docs/how-to/store-screenshots.md §5.

01-library.shows: The library: the default mosaic, grouped by day

02-collections.shows: Collections: Favourites and Duplicates, three albums with their covers, the years and the Trash

03-album.shows: The Outdoors album (31 photos), made through New album and filled from a library selection

04-viewer.shows: One photo full screen in the viewer, made a favourite with its heart

05-months.shows: The library grouped by month, through its grouping button

landing.about: Keyed android/phonelanding/<lang>/[dark/]NN-screen (landing_shot calls in the walk). The published Android set (2026-11-16) was captured by hand on an emulator paired into the maintainer's own realm, not by the scripted walk (docs/how-to/store-screenshots.md §9).

ios.about: The iOS twin (scripts/store-screenshots.sh --set landing): the same names and the same content, captured by landingShot calls in the UI test below over the shipping Debug app, keyed ios/iphone69landing/<lang>/[dark/]NN-screen.

02-album.shows: The Autumn walks album, made through Collections → New album and filled from a library selection

03-viewer.shows: One photo full screen in the viewer, with its date and actions

play.about: The Google Play set (2026-11-16), keyed android/phone/en/NN-screen and framed by scripts/store-frame render photos --device phone into android/phoneframed/<lang>/ with the captions in play/<locale>/captions.txt. Captured by hand, not by a walk: a 1080x2400 emulator paired into the maintainer's realm, the landing stock set uploaded through Drive's Folder upload into one folder (plus four exact copies for Duplicates), and the maintainer's own newer photos moved to Photos' trash for the library and month captures, then restored (docs/how-to/store-screenshots.md §9). The names follow the iOS list where the screen is the same; 06 and 07 are new. The German framed set puts German captions over these English captures: there is no android/phone/de capture.
